{"formalization":"abbrev Account := String

/- The vault's recorded state plus two money-flow ledgers kept so the money
   rules can be stated. `balances a` is the NEAR the contract records as
   credited to `a`. `deposited a` is the total yoctoNEAR that has actually
   arrived at the contract account from `a`. `received a` is the total
   yoctoNEAR the contract has actually paid out to `a` (gross: when a caller
   names itself as receiver, any gas it spends comes out of its own account
   and stays outside this ledger). -/
structure State where
  owner : Account
  deposits_paused : Bool
  balances : Account → Nat
  deposited : Account → Nat
  received : Account → Nat

/- 0.01 NEAR in yoctoNEAR: the only shortfall tolerated between what a
   deposit credits and the NEAR that actually arrives (storage staking
   that a first deposit can cost the contract). -/
def storageMargin : Nat := 10000000000000000000000

/- One call to the contract: signing account first, then the method's
   arguments, then the attached deposit for the payable method. -/
inductive Call where
  | new (caller : Account) (newOwner : Account)
  | deposit (caller : Account) (attached : Nat)
  | withdraw (caller : Account) (amount : Nat) (receiver : Account)
  | set_deposits_paused (caller : Account) (paused : Bool)

/- The account that signed the call. -/
def signer : Call → Account
  | .new c _ => c
  | .deposit c _ => c
  | .withdraw c _ _ => c
  | .set_deposits_paused c _ => c

/- One call is one indivisible step: a transfer that `withdraw` schedules
   completes within the same step. A call the contract rejects leaves the
   state unchanged and its attached deposit is refunded, so nothing
   arrives and nothing is paid out. The vault modeled here is the deployed,
   already-initialized contract, so `new` always aborts. -/
def step (s : State) : Call → State
  | .new _ _ => s
  | .deposit c amt =>
      if s.deposits_paused = true then s
      else if amt = 0 then s
      else
        { s with
          balances := fun a => if a = c then s.balances a + amt else s.balances a,
          deposited := fun a => if a = c then s.deposited a + amt else s.deposited a }
  | .withdraw c amt r =>
      if amt = 0 then s
      else if s.balances c < amt then s
      else
        { s with
          balances := fun a => if a = c then s.balances a - amt else s.balances a,
          received := fun a => if a = r then s.received a + amt else s.received a }
  | .set_deposits_paused c p =>
      if c = s.owner then { s with deposits_paused := p } else s","properties":[{"rule":"R1","statement":"∀ (s : State) (c : Account) (amt : Nat), ((step s (Call.deposit c amt)).balances c - s.balances c) ≤ ((step s (Call.deposit c amt)).deposited c - s.deposited c) + storageMargin ∧ ((step s (Call.deposit c amt)).deposited c - s.deposited c) ≤ ((step s (Call.deposit c amt)).balances c - s.balances c) + storageMargin"},{"rule":"R2","statement":"∀ (s : State) (c : Account) (amt : Nat) (r : Account), (s.balances c - (step s (Call.withdraw c amt r)).balances c) ≤ ((step s (Call.withdraw c amt r)).received r - s.received r) ∧ ((step s (Call.withdraw c amt r)).received r - s.received r) ≤ (s.balances c - (step s (Call.withdraw c amt r)).balances c)"},{"rule":"R3","statement":"∀ (s : State) (c : Account) (amt : Nat), s.deposits_paused = true → (step s (Call.deposit c amt)).balances = s.balances"},{"rule":"R4","statement":"∀ (s : State) (c : Call), signer c ≠ s.owner → (step s c).deposits_paused = s.deposits_paused"},{"rule":"R5","statement":"∀ (s : State) (c : Account) (o : Account), step s (Call.new c o) = s"}]}
